Run this entire Rnotebook to perform extraction of CasOFFinder sites from BigWig datafiles. 

NOTE: this is very memory intensive (requires 32~64GB RAM). 


LIBRARIES
```{r}
source("./_resources/basicFunctions_v2.R")

```


Load basic data for CasOffinder & initial pre-processing of data to construct ranges for analysis
```{r}
# read datafile & apply basic check for position 8-9 CT
path_casoffinder_data <- "./_resources/casoffinder_14bp_sequences_4mm.out.gz"


tb_casoffinder <- vroom(
  file = path_casoffinder_data,
  col_names = c(
    "gRNA_query",
    "target_chr",
    "target_position",
    "target_seq",
    "target_strand",
    "mm_count"
  )
) %>% mutate(CT_match = check_CT_match(string = target_seq, positions = c(8, 9)))


# make GRanges, resize to a quantification window of CT-centered +/- 500bps
gr_casoffinder <- tb_casoffinder %>%  make_casoffinder_granges() %>% GenomicRanges::resize(width = 1000, fix = "center")


# # check output
# gr_casoffinder



#
# Loop through input bigwigs and extract data from sites defined by CasOFFinder results

# get bigwig file paths
path_bigwigs <- "./_step1_precompute/_input/"
list_bigwigs <- list.files(path = path_bigwigs,
                         pattern = "*.cov.bw",
                         full.names = TRUE)

# check
list_bigwigs


#
# combine bigwigs and CasOffinder and output to Rdata files
output_Rdata <- "./_step1_precompute/_output/"

map(.x = list_bigwigs,
    .f = ~combine_bigwig_casoffinder(
      input_bigwig = .x,
      output_dir = output_Rdata,
      gr_casoffinder = gr_casoffinder
    ))

```
